benchmark_metadata.title: Multimodal Cybersecurity Incident Investigation Query Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.description: Reproducible benchmark query set covering text-only, visual-only, and cross-modal cybersecurity incident investigation tasks.

queries.query: What evidence demonstrates unauthorized PowerShell execution policy bypass during the incident?
queries.description: Requires cross-referencing host telemetry (EVTX/Mordor), SOC briefing report (DOCX), and visual SIEM alert screenshot.

queries.query: Show terminal console captures and visual proof of Mimikatz logonpasswords execution.
queries.description: Targets visual terminal capture screenshot showing interactive Mimikatz session and sekurlsa dump.

queries.query: What does the visual attack flow diagram show regarding lateral movement and C2 beaconing?
queries.description: Targets the architecture diagram showing multi-stage attack kill-chain progression.

queries.query: What critical severity indicators of compromise are listed in the threat intelligence IOC table?
queries.description: Targets the visual IOC matrix image table containing confirmed indicators and ATT&CK IDs.

queries.query: What is the CVSS base score and CWE classification for Log4Shell CVE-2021-44228?
queries.description: Queries authoritative NVD vulnerability knowledge base.

queries.query: What network flow statistics and packet rates indicate Denial of Service (DoS) traffic?
What techniques and tools were used for credential dumping and LSASS memory access?
queries.description: Retrieves MITRE T1003, Mordor PsExec secrets dump logs, and Mimikatz terminal screenshot.
